title: CloudFront + API performance
topic: CloudFront cache behaviors for /api/*, cache policies vs origin Cache-Control, X-Cache hit/miss, API Gateway stage vs usage-plan throttling, CloudFront vs ElastiCache vs API GW cache, invalidation vs TTL, globalskiatlas.com production patterns
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-26-cloudfront-api-caching.md and night-26-lab-cloudfront-setup scripts. Answer without peeking at night-26-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: globalskiatlas.com serves static HTML from S3 and wiki JSON from API Gateway behind one CloudFront distribution. GET /api/wiki/pages should reach Lambda on every request until you design explicit edge caching. Which cache policy on the api/wiki* behavior is the safe starting point?

options.A: CachingDisabled — dynamic API responses must not be edge-cached by default
options.B: CachingOptimized — reuse the default S3 behavior for every API path pattern
options.C: Elemental-MediaPackage — optimized for HLS video segments served at the edge
options.D: UseOriginCacheControl — skip attaching any managed cache policy object at all

questions.question: After enabling a permissive CloudFront cache policy on GET /api/iceberg-stats, the second identical request still shows X-Cache: Miss. Lambda returns JSON without Cache-Control or Expires. What is the most likely fix?

options.A: Add Route 53 latency routing so viewers always hit the closest us-east-1 edge POP
options.B: Have the origin return Cache-Control (e.g. public, max-age=60) so CloudFront may store it
options.C: Enable API Gateway stage caching — claim CloudFront cannot cache any API responses
options.D: Switch the behavior to target S3 instead of API Gateway for all JSON API paths

questions.question: A partner mobile app must be limited to 1,000 requests per day with burst protection, using a key you issue per partner. Which API Gateway feature primary enforces per-client limits?

options.A: AWS WAF rate-based rule on the CloudFront distribution only
options.B: Lambda reserved concurrency set to 1,000 on the integration function
options.C: Usage plan with API key — throttle and quota applied per issued key
options.D: CloudFront Origin Shield placed in the API Gateway Region

questions.question: Night 23 placed Redis in front of Aurora for resort_stats rows inside the VPC. Night 26 discusses CloudFront in front of /api/*. How do the two caches differ?

options.A: They are interchangeable — disable Redis whenever CloudFront caching is enabled
options.B: ElastiCache replaces CloudFront for static S3 assets at a lower monthly cost
options.C: CloudFront only caches S3 objects; API Gateway responses always bypass the CDN
options.D: CloudFront caches HTTP at the edge; ElastiCache caches app objects near compute

questions.question: Wiki POST /api/wiki/pages requires a Cognito JWT. GET /api/wiki/pages is anonymous. You consider edge-caching GET responses. Which cache-key design avoids serving one user's draft to another?

options.A: Cache only anonymous GETs — omit Authorization or cache a public subset
options.B: Include Authorization in the cache key and set TTL to 24 hours for all users
options.C: Use weighted Route 53 routing between cached and uncached behaviors
options.D: Enable POST in CachedMethods so CloudFront invalidates on every write

questions.question: Traffic to your REST API stage exceeds the configured steady-state rate but stays within burst capacity for a few seconds. What HTTP status do clients typically receive when limits are exceeded?

options.A: 503 Service Unavailable returned from a CloudFront custom error response page
options.B: 429 Too Many Requests — API Gateway throttle limit has been reached
options.C: 403 Forbidden — IAM explicitly denies the execute-api:Invoke API call
options.D: 502 Bad Gateway — Lambda integration timed out on every throttled request

questions.question: Your CloudFront distribution has behaviors: default * → S3, api/wiki* → Wiki API, api/iceberg-stats → stats API. A request arrives for GET /api/iceberg-stats. Which behavior matches?

options.A: Default * — CloudFront always prefers the longest wildcard path
options.B: Random weighted choice between the two configured API behaviors
options.C: Most specific path pattern — api/iceberg-stats before api/wiki*
options.D: Default * because iceberg-stats is not nested under api/wiki*

questions.question: Frequently updated JSON at /api/iceberg-stats should not require paid invalidations on every deploy. What is the exam-favored approach?

options.A: Disable compression on the cache behavior to force revalidation each time
options.B: Create a new CloudFront distribution per deploy for zero stale edge data
options.C: Use S3 Cross-Region Replication on the API Gateway deployment stage
options.D: Short TTL or origin Cache-Control max-age — let entries expire naturally

questions.question: An exam scenario asks where to view CacheHitRate for a CloudFront distribution serving globalskiatlas.com. Which namespace and Region combination is correct?

options.A: AWS/CloudFront in us-east-1 with DistributionId and Region=Global
options.B: AWS/ApiGateway in every edge POP Region tracked separately
options.C: AWS/Lambda in us-east-1 only — CloudFront publishes no metrics
options.D: AWS/S3 in the bucket Region — CacheHitRate is an S3 storage metric

questions.question: Which HTTP methods can CloudFront cache at the edge when listed in CachedMethods for an API behavior?

options.A: All seven methods if the origin returns HTTP 200 for the request
options.B: GET and HEAD only among cacheable methods — not POST/PUT/DELETE
options.C: POST only — GET always goes to origin for API Gateway backends
options.D: OPTIONS and PATCH — required for CORS preflight response caching

questions.question: Account-wide API traffic spikes across many APIs in us-east-1. Some stages have not set custom throttle limits. What still caps total invoke rate?

options.B: DynamoDB on-demand capacity units for every API integration
options.C: API Gateway account-level throttle limits that apply Region-wide
options.D: Route 53 health-check failure thresholds on the API custom domain

questions.question: You need to protect a regional ALB from HTTP floods. WAF is already on CloudFront for the public site. Where do you attach a REGIONAL-scoped Web ACL for the ALB?

options.A: Any Region — WAF ACLs are treated as global resources for every AWS service
options.B: eu-west-1 — closest edge POP Region to European viewer traffic for the ALB
options.C: CloudFront edge only — Application Load Balancers cannot attach WAF Web ACLs
options.D: Same Region as the ALB — REGIONAL scope, unlike CloudFront WAF in us-east-1

questions.question: Lambda behind API Gateway averages 800 ms; clients report slow TTFB on cache misses. CloudFront OriginLatency metric is high. First performance step before adding ElastiCache?

options.A: Optimize Lambda duration and cache cacheable GETs at CloudFront when safe
options.B: Enable Multi-AZ configuration on the API Gateway REST API stage settings
options.C: Increase edge TTL to 86400 seconds on all wiki paths including mutating POST
options.D: Replace the HTTP API with S3 website hosting for every JSON API payload path

questions.question: Exam contrast: API Gateway REST API stage cache vs CloudFront cache behavior for the same GET endpoint exposed via CloudFront → API GW → Lambda.

options.A: They are the same service — enable only one cache layer at a time
options.B: Stage cache is Regional at API Gateway; CloudFront cache is at edge POPs
options.C: CloudFront stage cache requires Redis running inside the application VPC
options.D: API Gateway cache only works when the integration target is DynamoDB

questions.question: A viral article causes millions of identical GET /api/wiki/pages requests worldwide. DynamoDB read capacity is spiking. Which layered approach best cuts database reads?

options.A: Disable CloudFront entirely — send all traffic directly to the API Gateway DNS name
options.B: Usage plan with zero quota — block all readers until the worldwide traffic spike ends
options.C: CloudFront edge cache on anonymous GET plus origin Cache-Control; ElastiCache optional deeper
options.D: Athena SQL over a wiki DynamoDB export — replace live reads for the duration of the spike
